title: Fixa adapter status (adapters/status.json)
description: Adapter id to the e-service state. Signed with fixa-cli sign (status.json.sig). There is no free text: the app shows its own words for each state.

state.description: ok: works. degraded: the form changed, sends may stop and fall back to e-mail. down: the e-service is off.

updated.description: ISO 8601 time the state was set.
